description: List the outfits (coordinates) saved under UserData/coordinate/{female,male} — the files Studio's own costume tab offers. Paths feed studio_set_character_outfit's 'coordinate'. An outfit file carries no sex marker of its own, so the folder is the only signal: a female outfit on a male character is refused on the path, not on the content. The first call reads the header of every file once (~2000 of them) and is then served from cache until a file changes on disk.

sex.description: restrict to one folder; omit for both

query.description: case-insensitive substring matched against the outfit name and its path

path.description: path relative to UserData/coordinate, e.g. 'female/school.png' — pass it as-is to studio_set_character_outfit

name.description: the name stored in the file, which is what Studio's list shows; it is NOT kept anywhere once the outfit is worn, so it cannot be read back from a character
